parallels.note: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then…

translations.web: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
translations.bsb: Indeed, no one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house.
translations.kjv: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
translations.asv: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
